stops.name: Nelson Piquet
stops.source: https://www.grandprix.com/gpe/rr388.html ("Piquet stopped without losing the lead on lap 28"); also https://www.historyracingpedia.com/stories/nl/f1-1983-south-africa-titledecider-piquet-prost.html ("In lap 28 he could come for fuel and tyres")
stops.note: planned fuel-and-tyre stop; Motor Sport (Nov 1983) gives 12 s stationary by the Brabham crew's watch, 9.2 s by the TV count

notes: Planned refuelling stops by most front-runners; only Piquet's in-lap is sourced. Motor Sport Nov 1983 (https://www.motorsportmagazine.com/archive/article/november-1983/66/south-african-grand-prix-9/) describes Patrese (#6) serviced 'in just over ten seconds', Lauda (#8) held on the jacks 'more than 23 sec' by a baulking right-rear wheel, and Tambay (#27) losing a place to de Cesaris at his stop, all without laps. historyracingpedia gives Brabham's pre-race plan (stops on laps 27 and 46) and Renault's (36 and 42): plans, not actual laps, so not entered.
